title: A Morning Without Nagging
creativeBrief: Love → chaos → hope → solution. Sell the parent identity: Jag vill vara den föräldern. No stars, no rewards on screen. No app in this film — understanding comes from the child acting, not from UI. Validation scene: shoes alone.

Same Swedish family home now 07:08, wall clock visible, morning chaos erupts, child on floor refusing socks, toothbrush on counter, open backpack, father exhales with tired loving frustration not anger, handheld documentary energy, painful recognition, Nordic winter kitchen light, no phones, no readable text
